_note: Supply-chain cause graph. Columns run left->right: 0 source / chokepoint, 1 port / storage, 2 commodity, 3 processing, 4 end users. share = approximate % of the flow on that edge (EIA, IEA, USDA, ICSG, TrendForce public estimates, rounded). chokepoint = id in app/api/bmap_routes.CHOKEPOINTS for the live status.

crude.title: CRUDE OIL
crude.unit: share of seaborne crude / product flow

nodes.label: Strait of Hormuz
nodes.note: ~20 mb/d of oil and ~20% of LNG (Qatar) - no real bypass beyond the Saudi East-West and UAE Habshan-Fujairah pipelines.

nodes.label: Bab el-Mandeb
nodes.note: Red Sea entrance; Houthi attacks pushed traffic around the Cape in 2024.

nodes.label: Suez / SUMED
nodes.note: Canal + SUMED pipeline: Gulf crude and Russian products to Europe / Asia.

nodes.label: Bosporus
nodes.note: Russian / Kazakh (CPC) crude and Black Sea grain exports.

nodes.label: Strait of Malacca
nodes.note: Main lane from the Gulf to China, Japan and Korea.

nodes.label: Danish Straits
nodes.note: Baltic exit for Russian crude and products (Primorsk, Ust-Luga).

nodes.label: US Gulf Coast
nodes.note: Permian crude exports and most US LNG export capacity; hurricane exposed.

nodes.label: Ras Tanura tank farm
nodes.note: Largest crude export terminal (Saudi Aramco).

nodes.label: Fujairah storage
nodes.note: Bunkering + storage hub outside Hormuz; weekly inventories are a sentiment gauge.

nodes.label: Cushing, OK
nodes.note: WTI delivery point: tank levels drive the front spread.

nodes.label: Rotterdam / ARA
nodes.note: Europe's refining and storage hub.

nodes.label: Ningbo-Zhoushan
nodes.note: China's largest crude import + storage port.

nodes.label: Ras Laffan (Qatar)
nodes.note: World's largest LNG export complex - entirely inside Hormuz.

nodes.label: Sabine Pass / Freeport
nodes.note: US LNG export terminals (Cheniere, Freeport).

nodes.label: Crude oil
nodes.note: Brent (seaborne) and WTI (US inland).

nodes.label: LNG / gas
nodes.note: TTF (Europe) prices the marginal cargo; Henry Hub is the US feed-gas cost.

nodes.label: Refining
nodes.note: Margins = product cracks; outages and crude spikes squeeze or widen them.

nodes.label: Gasoline / diesel / jet
nodes.note: RBOB gasoline and ULSD (heating oil) futures.

nodes.label: Tanker + LNG shipping
nodes.note: Longer routes (Cape detour) = more tonne-miles = higher day rates.

nodes.label: EU / Asia regas + utilities
nodes.note: E.ON, TEPCO: importers of the marginal LNG cargo.

nodes.label: Airlines
nodes.note: Jet fuel is ~25-30% of airline costs.

nodes.label: Petrochemicals
nodes.note: Naphtha / ethane feedstock costs.

nodes.label: Consumers / inflation
nodes.note: Pump prices feed headline CPI and rate expectations.

nodes.label: EU industry + power
nodes.note: German industry and power prices track TTF.

nodes.label: Odesa / Novorossiysk
nodes.note: Ukraine + Russia ship ~30% of world wheat exports.

nodes.label: Panama Canal
nodes.note: US Gulf grain and LNG to Asia; drought cut transits in 2023.

nodes.label: US Corn Belt / Mississippi
nodes.note: Corn + soy down the Mississippi to the Gulf; low river levels throttle barges.

nodes.label: Brazil (Santos / Paranagua)
nodes.note: #1 soybean exporter.

nodes.label: Wheat / corn / soy
nodes.note: CBOT grain complex.

nodes.label: Grain traders + processors
nodes.note: ADM, Bunge: crush and origination margins.

nodes.label: Food producers
nodes.note: Input-cost pass-through with a lag.

nodes.label: Livestock / feed
nodes.note: Corn and meal are the main feed costs.

nodes.label: Chile (Escondida)
nodes.note: ~24% of mined copper; Escondida is the largest mine.

nodes.label: Peru (Las Bambas)
nodes.note: ~10%; protests / road blockades cut shipments.

nodes.label: DRC / Zambia
nodes.note: ~14% and rising; cobalt by-product.

nodes.label: Antofagasta / Callao ports
nodes.note: Concentrate + cathode export ports.

nodes.label: Copper
nodes.note: COMEX copper.

nodes.label: Smelters (China ~50%)
nodes.note: Treatment charges collapse when concentrate is short.

nodes.label: Grid + data centers
nodes.note: Transmission, transformers, AI data-center build-out.

nodes.label: EVs + construction
nodes.note: An EV uses 3-4x the copper of a combustion car.

nodes.label: Lithography (Netherlands)
nodes.note: Sole EUV supplier.

nodes.label: Taiwan Strait
nodes.note: Blockade / quarantine risk; also earthquakes (Hualien 2024).

nodes.label: TSMC fabs (Hsinchu / Tainan)
nodes.note: ~90% of leading-edge logic.

nodes.label: Advanced chips
nodes.note: Semiconductor index as the price of the chain.

nodes.label: Packaging + HBM (Korea)
nodes.note: SK hynix / Samsung HBM, CoWoS packaging.

nodes.label: AI accelerators
nodes.note: GPU makers are TSMC's largest leading-edge customers.

nodes.label: Phones + PCs
nodes.note: Consumer devices on N3 / N5.
